documents.title: Payroll portal outage: current status · Workaround + Updates
documents.text:
## Workaround
Expense claims can be submitted by email to the finance shared mailbox; they will be processed when the portal is back. Payroll itself runs on schedule; salaries are not affected.

## Updates
Updates are posted on the IT status page every two hours.
